job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS 2022 RFP for real assets investment consultant services?
job.acceptance: November30,2022 at 4:30pm HST; issue date and RFP number optional.

reviews.reason: This is an August 2021 Orange County Employees Retirement System RFP, not the Hawaii ERS 2022 RFP. Its proposal deadline therefore does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: Requests for Proposal Issued August 2021 Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS)
Those who wish to be considered must submit their completed proposal, via email to the Point of Contact, by 5:00 p.m., PT, October 1, 2021.
